title: APCTT submission.json (apctt-submission-v3)
description: The identity file of a minimal Stage 1 submission zip (decisions D59, D64): who submits which package, for the common base environment of this kit. tools/make_submission.py fills declared_package_sha256. models lists the catalogue models the module uses (catalog_id, from contracts/model-catalog.json) and the weights the team ships in the bundle as team-trained (path; a fine-tune or adapter of a catalogue model names it in base_model). The same rules apply to every team and every submission.

base_id.description: the common base environment the module was built for: base_id of this kit's contracts/base-environment.json

declared_package_sha256.description: the kit's package hash of participant_module/ and assets/; written by tools/make_submission.py

license.description: MIT (decision D72), the same licence as participant_module/LICENSE

catalog_id.description: a model of contracts/model-catalog.json; the organizer provides it in APCTT_MODEL_STORE

path.description: team-trained weights: the file or folder inside the bundle

base_model.description: for a fine-tune or adapter: the catalog_id of the catalogue model it was made from
